intro: In the 26 days leading up to May 3, 2026, ZCyberNews published 53 articles under the social-engineering tag, with 41 classified as high severity. Lazarus Group, UNC6692, and APT37 (ScarCruft, InkySquid) were the most frequently observed threat actors. The campaigns primarily targeted the cryptocurrency, financial services, technology, financial-services, and hospitality sectors across Global, North America, Europe, the United States, and Canada. The coverage spans from April 8 to May 3, 2026, reflecting a concentrated period of social-engineering activity.
